name: MISP
label: MISP REST API — events, attributes, feeds, galaxies, orgs
description: Official MISP Automation API (OpenAPI 2.5) via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://www.misp-project.org/openapi/. Auth Authorization raw API key (empty prefix). mispHost is host without scheme. Event data is often personal or law-enforcement sensitive. Sharing groups / TLP apply. TLS is always verified.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: create-attribute | get-attribute | list-attributes | search-attributes | update-attribute | delete-attribute | create-event | get-event | list-events | search-events | update-event | delete-event | publish-event | unpublish-event | add-event-tag | remove-event-tag | create-feed | get-feed | list-feeds | update-feed | enable-feed | disable-feed | get-galaxy | list-galaxies | delete-galaxy | get-noticelist | list-noticelists | search-objects | create-org | get-org | list-orgs | update-org | delete-org | create-tag | list-tags | update-tag | delete-tag | create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | get-warninglist | list-warninglists.

schema.label: eventId
schema.description: MISP event id for attribute/event/tag ops.

schema.label: attributeId
schema.description: MISP attribute id.

schema.label: tagId
schema.description: MISP tag id.

schema.label: local
schema.description: add-event-tag local flag. 0 or 1.

schema.label: feedId
schema.description: Feed id.

schema.label: galaxyId
schema.description: Galaxy id.

schema.label: noticelistId
schema.description: Noticelist id.

schema.label: organisationId
schema.description: Organisation id.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: User id.

schema.label: warninglistId
schema.description: Warninglist id.

schema.label: Event
schema.description: Official Event object wrapper for create-event / update-event / search-events. Example: {"info":"Phishing","distribution":"0"}.

schema.label: Attribute
schema.description: Official Attribute object wrapper for create-attribute / update-attribute. Example: {"type":"ip-dst","value":"1.2.3.4"}.

schema.label: Feed
schema.description: Official Feed object for create-feed / update-feed.

schema.label: Organisation
schema.description: Official Organisation object for create-org / update-org.

schema.label: Tag
schema.description: Official Tag object {name, colour} for create-tag / update-tag.

schema.label: User
schema.description: Official User object for create-user / update-user.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank. Paths from MISP OpenAPI 2.5.

configurationParameters.label: MISP host
configurationParameters.description: MISP host without scheme. Example: misp.example.com. OfficialApiNode URL-encodes path placeholders.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: MISP auth key. Header Authorization with empty prefix (raw key). StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in logs.
